tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'i sdom tshig bzhugs// ༄༅// rigs kyi khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis// sngon 'gro sbyangs nas mtshams gcad bya// gnas dang mchod pa byin phab nas// bdag bskyed mchod nas bzlas pa bya// bum pa gsal gdab mchod nas bzla// dkyil 'khor bsgrubs nas byin gyis brlab// mchod bstod gtor ma rnams bdun gtang*// gtso mo'i bum steng mchod rten ni// ming byang bcas la kun tu dang*// dūr ba sngags dang bcas pas mchod// phyogs bzhi'i gtor ma phyogs nas gtang*// so so'i gtor bcas lha gzhan la// gsol ba btab nas slar yang mchod// byur bsal dug dbyung rnam gnyis bya// rgyal bar byed pas bslangs nas ni// gos sar rgyan gyis brgyan byas nas// dbang bskur don du gsol ba gdab// spyi bor bum bzhag sor 'brang gi /gzungs rings gnyis dang sngags gzhan gyis// dbang bskur nas ni sngags kyis bsrung*// bsrung 'khor gdags shing rdo rjes bsrung*// bden pa'i stobs kyis bsrung byas nas// sman nam zas la bden pa'i stobs// brjod nas mnga' dbul shis pa brjod// yon blang mchod bstod gshegs su gsol// dam pas bskul nas 'phags pas sbyar// //de nas yon gyi bdag pos maṇ+ḍal phul la me tog bzung nas 'di skad ces/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ba re/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rig pa'i dbang bskur ba rdo rje'i go cha chen po'i phyag rgyas btab pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya a dhi ṣ+ṭhi te badz+ra swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog dang spos thogs la 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes 'don pa bsgyur la lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas spyi bor bum pa bzhag nas 'di skad ces/ na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsaṃ ghā ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā nāṃ/ na mo na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa dharma saṃ ghe bh+yaḥ

tad+ya thā/ oṃ bi pu la gar+bhe bi pu la bi ma le/ oṃ bi ma le gar+bhe/ bi ma le dza ya gar+bhe/ badz+ra dz+wa la gar+bhe/ ga ti ga ha ni ga ga ne bi sho dha ne/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ne/ oṃ gu ṇa pa ti ga ga na bi tsā ri ni/ ga ga ri ṇi ga ga ri ṇi/ gi ri gi ri/ gi ri ṇi gi ri ṇi/ ga ma ri ga ma ri/ ga ma ni ra ga ma ni ra/ ga ha ri ga ha ri/ ga ha ga ha/ garga ri garga ri/ ga ga ri ga ga ri/ gam+bha ri gam+bhi ri/ ga bhi ga bhi/ ga hi ga hi/ ga ha ga ha/ ga ma ni ga ma ni/ ga re ga re/ gu ru gu ru/ gu bha gu bha/ gu ha gu ha/ gu ru gu ru/ gu ru ṇi gu ru ṇi/ tsu lu tsu lu/ tsa le tsa le/ gu ha ṇi gu ha ṇi/ gu ru ṇi gu ru ṇi/ tsu lu tsu lu/ tsa le tsa le/ sa mu tsa le/ dza ye bi dza yai/ dza ye ba ti/ a pa rā dzi te/ sarba bha ya bi ga te/ gar+bha saṃ bha ra ṇi/ si ri si ri/ bi ri bi ri/ mi ri mi ri/ pi ri pi ri/ ṣi ri ṣi ri/ bha ga wa ti sa man+ta/ ā kar+ṣa ṇi/ sarba sha trūṃ pra marda ni/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ/ sarba satwā nāñca sarba dā/ sarba bha ye bh+yaḥ sarba u pa dra be bh+yaḥ sarba byā dhi bh+yāḥ tsi ri tsi ri/ bi ri bi ri/ dhi ri dhi ri/ bi ga ta a war+ṇi bi sho dha ni/ bi bi dha a ba ra ṇa bi nā sha ni mu ni mu ni/ mu tsi mu tsi/ mu li mu li/ tsi li tsi li/ ka ma le bi ma le na/ dza ya bi dza ya/ dza ya ba he dza ya ba ti/ bi she ṣa ba ti bha ga wā tī/ rat+na ma ku ṭa/ ma la dha ri ba hu bi bi dha/ bi tsi tra be sha dha ri ṇi/ bha ga wa tī ma hā bid+yā de bī rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ/ sa pa ri wā ra sarba sa twāñca sa man+ta da sarba tra/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ hu ru hu ru/ dhu ru dhu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ/ sarba sa twāñca a nā tha/ na trā nā na la ya na/ nā ga shā ra ṇa pa ra ya ṇā na/ pa ri mo tsa ya sarba duḥkhe bh+yaḥtsaṇ+ḍi tsaṇ+ḍi/ tsaṇ+ṭe tsaṇ+ṭe/ tsaṇ+ḍi ni tsaṇ+ḍi ni/ be ga wa ti sarba duṣ+ṭa ni wā ri ṇi/ bi dza ya bā hi ni/

hu ru hu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ tu ru tu ru/ ā yuḥpā la ni/ su ra ba ri/ pra ma tha ni/ sarba de wa ga ṇa pū dzi ti/ tsi ri tsi ri/ dhi ri dhi ri/ sa man+ta a ba lo ki te/ pra bhe pra bhe/ su pra bha wa bi shud+dhe/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ dhu ru dhu ru/ dha ra ṇi/ dha re dha ra dha ra/ su mu su mu/ mu su mu su/ su mu ru su mu ru/ ru ru tsa le tsa la ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭā na pū ra ya/ a shaṃ māṃ/ shrī wa su dhā re/ dza ya ka ma le/ k+ṣi ṇi k+ṣi ṇi/ ba ra da aṃ ku she oṃ pad+ma bi shud+dhe/ sho dha ya sho d+dha ya/ shud+dhe shud+dhe/ bha ra bha ra/ bhi ri bhi ri/ bhu ru bhu ru/ maṃ ga la bi shud+dhe/ pa wi tra mu khi/ khaḍ+gi ni khaḍ+gi ni/ kha ra kha ra/ dza li ta shi ta shi kha re/ sa man+ta a ba lo ki te pra bhe su pra bi shud+dhe/ sa man+ta pra shā ri ta a ba bhā ṣi ta shud+dhe/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ sarba de wa ga ṇa gra ha na k+ṣa tra/ sa ma ā kar+ṣa ni/ sa d+ya pra te/ oṃ hrī trāṃ tā ra tā ra/ tā ra ya tā ra ya māṃ/ bha ga ba ti sarba satwāñca/ nā ga bi lo ki te/ la hu la hu/ hu lu hu lu/ hu ru hu ru/ laghu la ghu/ tu hu tu hu/ tu ru tu ru/ ki ṇi ki ṇi/ k+ṣi ṇi k+ṣi ṇi/ hu ṇi hu ṇi/ sarba gra ha bha k+ṣa ṇi/ piṃ ga li piṃ ga li/ mu tsu mu tsu/ su mu su mu/ su bi tsa ri/ ta ra ta ra/ nā ga bi lo ki tā ra ya māṃ/ sarba satwāñca san+sā rā/ ar+ṇaṇa tā/ bha ga wa tī aṣ+ṭa ma hā dā ru ṇa/ bha ye bh+yaḥ sarba tra sa man+te na di sha ban+dhe na/ badz+ra prā kā ra/ badz+ra pā sha ban+dhe na tsa/ badz+ra dz+wa lā bi shud+dhe/ bhu ri bhu ri/ bha ga wa tī gar+bha bi sho dha ni/ ku k+ṣi saṃ pū ra ṇi/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ tsa la tsa la/ dz+wa la ni dz+wa la ni/ bar+ṣa tu te wa sa man+te na da byi u da ke na/ a mṛ te bar+ṣa ṇi/ de wa tā a wa tā ra ṇi a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ su ga ta ba ra ba tsa na a mṛ ta pa ra su ṣe rak+ṣa rak+ṣa bha ga ba tī māṃ/ sarba tra sarba dā/

sarba bha ye bh+yaḥ sarba u pa dra be bh+yaḥ sarba u pa sargeg bh+yaḥ sarba byā dhi bh+yaḥ sarba duṣ+ṭa bha ya bhī te bh+yaḥ sarba ki li ka la ha/ bi gra ha bi bā dā dur+sawap+na durmit+ta/ a maṃ ga la pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa na ga bī dā ra ṇa/ tsa la tsa la/ ba la ba la/ ba la wa ti dza ya dza ya/ bi dza ya bi dza ya/ dza ya tu māṃ/ sarba tra sarba ka li sid+dh+yan+tu me i ma ma ma hā bid+yā sā dha ya maṇ+ḍa laṃ sā dha ya sa man+ta na/ ghā ta ya bigh+nān/ dza ya dza ya/ sid+dh+ye sid+dh+ye/ bud+dh+ya bud+dh+ya/ sid+dha sid+dha/ pū ra ya pū ra ya/ pū ra ṇi pū ra ṇi/ sū ra ya me ā shān/ sarba bi d+yā uṅga ta mūrti/ dza yor+ṇa te dza ya ba hi ni dza ya ba ti/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ bha ga ba tī/ sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya/ shud+dhe bya ba lo ka ya māṃ sa pa ri wā raṃ sarba satwāñca aṣ+ṭa ma hā dā ra ṇa bha ye shu sarba a shi pa ri pū ra ya/ tra ya swa ma hā ba ya bh+yaḥ sa ra sa ra/ pra sa ra pra sa ra/ sarba a ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ni/ sa man+ta ā ka ra maṇ+ḍa la bi shud+dhe/ bi ga te bi ga te ma le/ sarba ma la bi sho dha ni/ sarba maṃ ga la bi shud+dhe/ sarba a maṃ ga li bi sho dha ni/ k+ṣi ṇi k+ṣi ni/ sarba pā paṃ bi shud+dhe ma la bi ga ti/ dza ya ba ti te dzo ba ti/ badz+re badz+ra ba ti trai lo kya a dhiṣ+ṭhi te swā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta mūr+dha a bhi ṣe kaiḥswā hā/ sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa a bhi ṣe kaiḥswā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya shud+dhe swā hā/ sarba de wa tā a bhi ṣe kaiḥswā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya a dhiṣ+ṭhi te hṛ da ya swā hā/ sarba thā ga ta hṛ da ya sid+dhe swā hā/ in+d+re in+d+ra ba ti in+d+ra bya ba lo ki te swā hā/ brah+me brah+ma dhu ṣi te swā hā/ biṣ+ṇu na maskṛ tā ya swā hā/ ma he shwa ra ban+di ta pū dzi ta ye swā hā/ badz+ra dha ra ya badz+ra pā ṇi pa la bid+yā a dhiṣ+ṭhi te swā hā/ dhṛ ta rāṣ+ṭā ya swā hā/

bi rū ṭa kā ya swā hā/ bi rū pak+ṣa ye swā hā/ bai shra wa ṇā ya swā hā/ tsa turma hā rā dza na maskri tā ya swā hā/ ya mā ya swā hā/ ya ma pū dzi ta na maskri tā ya swā hā/ ba ru ṇā ya swā hā/ ma ru tā ya swā hā/ ma hā ma ru tā ya swā hā/ ag+na ye swā hā/ wā ya be swā hā/ nā ga bi lo ki tā ya swā hā/ de wa ga ṇe bh+yaḥswā hā/ nā ga ga ṇe bh+yaḥswā hā/ yak+ṣa ga ṇe bh+yaḥswā hā/ rak+ṣa sa ga ṇe bh+yaḥswā hā/ gan+dharba ga ṇe bh+yaḥswā hā/ a pa sā ra ga ṇe bh+yaḥswā hā/ a su ra ga ṇe bh+yaḥswā hā/ ga ru ḍa ga ṇe bh+yaḥswā hā/ kin+na ra ga ṇe bh+yaḥswā hā/ ma ho ra ga ga ṇe bh+yaḥswā hā/ ma nu ṣ+ya ga ṇe bh+yaḥswā hā/ a ma nu ṣ+ya ga ṇe bh+yaḥswā hā/ sarba gra he bh+yaḥswā hā/ sarba bhū te bh+yaḥswā hā/ sarba pre te bh+yaḥswā hā/ sarba pi shā tse bh+yaḥswā hā/ sarba un+mā de bh+yaḥswā hā/ sarba a pa smā re bh+yaḥswā hā// sarba kum+bhaṇ+ḍi bh+yaḥswā hā/ sarba pū ta ne bh+yaḥswā hā/ sarba ka ṭa pū ta ne bh+yaḥswā hā/ sarba duṣ+ṭa pra duṣ+ṭe bh+yaḥswā hā/ oṃ dhu ru dhu ru swā hā/ oṃ tu ru tu ru swā hā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ tsu ru tsu ru swā hā/ oṃ mu ru mu ru swā hā/ oṃ ha na ha na sarba sha trūṃ swā hā/ oṃ da ha da ha sarba duṣ+ṭā na swā hā/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pra t+yaṃ ar+thi kā pra t+ya a mi trā na swā hā/ ye ma ma a hi ta e ṣā na sarba te ṣa na shī ri raṃ dz+wa la ya dz+wa la ya swā hā/ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ tsit+ta nā na swā hā/ dz+wa li ta ye swā hā/ pra dz+wa li tā ya swā hā/ dī pa dz+wa lā ya swā hā/ badz+ra dz+wa lā ya swā hā/ ag+na ye dz+wa lā ya swā hā/ sa man+ta dz+wa lā ya swā hā/ ma ṇi bha drā ya swā hā/ pūr+ṇaṇa bha drā ya swā hā/ sa man+ta bha drā ya swā hā/ ma hā sa man+ta bha drā ya swā hā/ kā lā ya swā hā/ mahā kā lā ya swā hā/ ma trī ga ṇā ya swā hā/ yak+ṣa ṇī nāṃ swā hā/

rak+ṣa sa nī nāṃ swā hā/ pre ta pi shā tsa ḍā ki nī nāṃ swā hā/ ā kā shā ma trī nāṃ swā hā/ sa mu dra ga mi nī nāṃ swā hā/ sa mu dra bā si ṇī nāṃ swā hā/ rā tri tsa rā ṇāṃ swā hā/ di wā pa tsa rā ṇāṃ swā hā/ trā san+dh+ya tsa rā ṇāṃ swā hā/ be lā tsa rā ṇāṃ swā hā/ i be la tsa rā ṇāṃ swā hā/ garba ha re bh+yaḥswā hā/ garba hi ri ṇī bh+yaḥswā hā/ garba san+dha ra ṇī swā hā/ hu lu hu lu swā hā/ tsu lu tsu lu swā hā/ oṃ swā hā/ swa swā hā/ bhu swā hā/ bhu wa swā hā/ oṃ bhur+bhu wa swā hā/ tsi li tsi li swā hā/ tsi ṭi tsi ṭi swā hā/ bi ṭi bi ṭi swā hā/ dhā ri ṇi swā hā/ ag+ni swā hā/ te dz+wa wa pū swā hā/ tsi li tsi li swā hā/ mi li mi li swā hā/ si li si li swā hā/ bud+dh+ya bud+dh+ya swā hā/ sid+dh+ya sid+dh+ya swā hā/ maṇ+ḍa la ban+dhe swā hā/ si mā ban+dhe swā hā/ sarba sha trūṃ bhañja ya bhañja ya swā hā/ dzam+bha ya dzam+bha ya swā hā/ s+t+wam+bha ya s+t+wam+bha ya swā hā/ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da swā hā/ bhin+da bhin+da swā hā/ bhañja bhañja swā hā/ dzam+bha ya dzam+bha ya swā hā/ s+t+wam+bha ya s+t+wam+bha ya swā hā/ ban+dha ban+dha swā hā/ mo ha ya mo ha ya swā hā/ mo tsa ya mo tsa ya swā hā/ ma ṇi bi shud+dhe swā hā/ sūr+ya sūr+ya bi shud+dhe swā hā/ sho dha ni bi sho dha ni swā hā/ tsan+d+re tsan+d+re swā hā/ pūr+ṇaṇa tsan+d+re swā hā/ gra he bh+yaḥswā hā/ nak+ṣa tre bh+yaḥswā hā/ pi shā tse bh+yaḥswā hā/ bi shwa bh+yaḥswā hā/ shi bebh+yaḥswā hā/ shān+ti bh+yaḥswā hā/ puṣ+ṭi bh+yaḥswā hā/ swas+t+ya ni bh+yaḥswā hā/ shi baṃ ka ri swā hā/ shaṃ ka ri swā hā/ shān+ti ka ri swā hā/ puṣ+ṭi ka ri swā hā/ ba la brtā ni swā hā/ ba la bar+bhi ni ka ri swā hā/ shrī ka ri swā hā/ shrī bar+dha ni swā hā/ shrī dz+wa la ni swā hā/ mu tsi swā hā/ na mu tsi swā hā/ ma ru tsi swā hā/

be ga ba ti swā hā/ oṃ ta thā ga te mūrti/ pra ba ri bi ga ta bha ye swa ma ye swa me bha ga ba tī/ sarba sā sti ra bha wa tu ma ma sarba satwā nāñca swā hā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni/ bi mu ni bi mu ni/ ba ri tsi ri tsa lo ni/ bha ga ba ti dza ya bi ga ti bha ya ha ri ṇi/ bo dhi bo dhi/ bo dha ya bo dha ya/ bud+dhi li bud+dhi li/ tsum+bhi li tsum+bhi li/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya dzuṣ+ṭhi swā hā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni/ mu ni wa re a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba bid+yā a bhi ṣe kairma hā badz+ra ka pa tsa/ mu dri mu dri tī/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya a dhiṣ+ṭhi te badz+rā ya swā hā/ dbang bskur ba ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //tad+ya thā/ oṃ gi ri gi ri/ gi ri ṇi gi ri ba ti/ gu ṇa ba te/ ā kā sha ba ti/ ā kā sha bi shud+dhe/ sarba pā paṃ bi ga te/ ā kā she ga ga na ta le/ ā kā sha bi tsa ra ṇi dz+wa li ta shi kha re/ ma ṇi muk+te kha tsi ta mau li dha re/ su ke she/ su bak+t+re/ su ne tre su bar+ṇa gau rī a tī te/ a nut+pan+ne/ a nā ga te/ pra tat+yūt+pan+ne/ na maḥsarba ṣā na bud+dhā nā na/ dz+wa li ta te tsa sā na/ bud+dhe su bud+dhe/ bha ga wa tī/ su rak+ṣa ni su k+ṣa me/ su pra bhe/ su dha me/ su dān+te/ ba re bha ga wa tī/ bha dra ba ti/ bha dre/ su bha dre/ bi ma le/ dza ya bha dre/ tsaṇ+ḍe tsaṇ+ḍe/ pra tsaṇ+ḍe pra tsaṇ+ḍe/ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍe/ ma hā tsaṇ+ḍe/ gau rī/ gan+dha rī/ gau rī/ tsau rī/ tsaṇ+ḍā lī/ mā taṅgi/ ba tsa si/ puk+ka si/ su ma ti/ sha ba rī/ shaṅka ri/ drā mi ḍi/ rau tri ni/ sarba ar+tha sā dha ni/ ha na ha na/ sarba sha trūṃ/ da ha da ha/ sarba duṣ+ṭān/ pre ta pi shā tsa/ ḍā ki nī nā na/ ma nu ṣ+ya/ a ma nu ṣ+ya nāñca/ pa tsa pa tsa hṛ da yan/ gdon ma rungs pa rnams kyi srog gzhom du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das ma bdag gi sdig pa thams cad gzhig tu gsol/ gzhig tu gsol/ thams cad du 'jigs pa dang*/ gdon thams cad las bdag la bsrung du gsol/

bsrung du gsol/ ma rungs pa thams cad bcing du gsol/ sarba ki la bi ṣa nā sha ni/ marta daṇ+ḍi/ mā ni ni mā ni ni/ tsa le tsa le/ tsi ti tsi ti/ ti ṭi ti ṭi/ ti ṭi ni/ tu ṭe/ gau rī ni/ bīr+ya ni/ pra ba ra sa ma re/ tsan+d+rā lī/ ma taṅgi/ ru dha si/ brtsa si/ su ma ti/ a ma ri/ su mu ri/ puk+ka sī/ sha ba rī/ sha ma ri/ shaṅka ri/ drā mi ḍi/ da ha ni/ pa tsa ni/ ma tha ni/ marda ni/ sa ra le sa ra le/ sa ra laṃ bha bhi na ma d+yot+k+riṣ+ṭa/ bi dhā ra ṇi/ ma hi li/ ma ho ma hi li ni ga ḍe/ ni ga ḍa/ bhañje/ mat+ti mat+ti/ ni mat+te/ tsakra bā gi ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa le/ dz+wa le dzu le/ sha ba ri sha ba ri/ shā ba ri shā ba ri/ sarba byā dhi ha ra ṇi/ tsū ḍi tsū ḍi tsū ḍi ni/ tsū ḍa ma ṇi/ ni mi ni mi/ ni min+dha ri/ tri lo ka dza hi ni/ tri lo ka ā lo ka kā ri/ trai dhā tu ka bya ba lo ki ni/ badz+ra pā ra shu/ pā sha mut+ka ra/ khaḍ+ga shaṅkha tsakra tri shū la/ tsin+tā ma ṇi/ ma hā bid+yā dha ri ṇi/ bdag thams cad du gnas thams cad na gnas pa na ma rungs pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang*/ nad thams cad dang*/ 'jigs pa thams cad las bsrung du gsol/ bsrung du gsol lo// badz+ra badz+ra ba ti/ badz+ra pā ṇi dha re/ hi li hi li/ mi li mi li/ tsi li tsi li/ tsi mi li tsi mi li/ si li si li/ pi li pi li/ ba ra ba ra ba ra de/ sarba tra dza ya/ lab+dhe swā hā/ sarba pā pa bi dā ri ṇi swā hā/ sarba tra sarba byā dhi ha ra ṇi swā hā/ sarba tra sarba bha ya ha ra ṇi swā hā/ sam+bha ra ṇi swā hā/ swastir bha ba tu māṃ swā hā/ shān+ti swā hā/ puṣ+ṭi swā hā/ dza ya tu dza ye dza ye swā hā/ dza ya ba ti/ dza ya bi ma le/ bi pu le swā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta murti swā hā/ oṃ bhu ri bhu ri badz+ra pa ti/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya/ pū ri ṇi/ san+dha ri ṇi/ ba la ba la/ dza ya bīr+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ dbang bskur ba'i gzungs phyi ma ste bcu gsum pa'o//

//bden pa dang bden pa'i mchog gang gis/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la gnas pa'i tshig bden pa rnams dang*/ 'jig rten gyi tshig gi mchog dang*/ dge sbyong rnams kyi nang na dge sbyong skyid de ba zhes bya ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni 'jigs pa mi mnga' ba/ bag tsha ba mi mnga' ba ste/ mi skrag mi 'bros la 'jigs pa med cing*/ 'jigs pa dang*/ 'jigs par byed pa dang bral ba/ 'jigs pa dang*/ 'jigs par byed pa spangs pa/ skyi bur zhes byed pa med pa'o// zhes yang dag par smra bas smra ba ni/ dus su yang dag par smra bas smra ba yin te/ bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba la bde legs su gyur cig bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig gang gis tshul khrims dang*/ brtul zhugs dang*/ dka' thub dang*/ tshangs par spyod pa la gnas pa gang ci yang rung ba de dag gi nang na ni/ 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig des/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bde legs su gyur cig gnas brtan rgyal po'i bu thu bo dang 'dra ba rab tu byung nas ring du lon pa tshangs par spyod pa mngon par spyad pa rnams kyi mchog 'di lta ste/ dge slong kun shes kauṇ+ḍi n+ya dang*/ 'dod pa nyung ba dang*/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas pa dang*/ chog shes pa rnams kyi mchog 'od srungs chen po dang*/ shes rab che ba dang*/ spobs pa che ba rnams kyi mchog sha ra dwa ti'i bu dang*/ rdzu 'phrul che ba dang*/ mthu che ba rnams kyi mchog maung gal gyi bu chen po dang*/ lha'i mig dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog ma 'gags pa dang*/ mang du thos pa rnams kyi mchog kun dga' bo dang*/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog nye ba 'khor dang*/ chos smra ba rnams kyi mchog byams ma'i bu gang po dang*/ bslab pa la gus pa rnams kyi mchog sgra gcan 'dzin dang*/ mal cha dang stan bsko ba rnams kyi mchog gyad bu nor dang*/

seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pa rnams kyi mchog ba ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len dang*/ khyim bdag dang dad pa bskyed pa rnams kyi mchog nag po chen po 'char ka dang*/ lha dang mis mchod pa rnams kyi mchog legs mthong gi bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar bya'o// yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par bya'o// rgyal po'am/ chom rkun nam/ me'am/ chu'am/ dgra'am/ mi mdza' ba'am/ lam du 'gro ba'am/ lam log par 'gro ba'am/ gnyid log pa'am/ ra ro ba'am/ bag med pa thams cad las bsrung bar bya'o// bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig gang gis sems can rkang pa med pa'am/ rkang gnyis pa'am/ rkang bzhi pa'am/ rkang mangs sam/ gzugs can nam/ gzugs can ma yin pa'am/ 'du shes can nam/ 'du shes med pa'am/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi sems can ji snyed yod pa de dag gi nang na ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar bya'o// yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par bya'o// bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig gang gis 'dus byas sam/ 'dus ma byas kyi chos ji snyed yod pa de dag gi nang na ni 'dod chags dang bral ba mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar bya'o// yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par bya'o// bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig gang gis/ tshogs sam/ 'dus pa'am/ mang po'am/ 'khor ji snyed yod pa de dag gi nang na ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig des/ rgyal khams sam/ yul 'khor ram/ grong ngam/ grong rdal lam/ grong khyer ram/

khyim mam/ nags sam/ zhing ngam/ nad pa 'di la bsrung bar bya'o// yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ yongs su bskyang ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ mtshams gcad par bya'o// 'byung po thams cad bzlog par bya'o// gzi byin 'phrog pa rnams bzlog par bya'o// bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig gang gis/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngas 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug zad par bya ba'i phyir/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong bstan pa dang*/ bshad pa dang*/ brjod pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba'i nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zad par gyur cig med par gyur cig rab tu zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/ bden pa'i stobs kyis bsrung ba ste bcu bzhi pa'o// nad pa'i zas dang*/ skom dang*/ sman rnams kyang reg sngags 'dis btab ste stsal bar bgyi'o// rdzogs sangs rnam par sangs rgyas tshe// 'jig rten skyong bas phyogs bzhi nas// snod bzhi dag ni blangs nas su// bde bar gshegs la phul ba dang*// mthu yis gcig tu sprul mdzad pa// lha yi snod mchog de dang ni// bdud rtsi 'dra ba'i sman gyi rnams// ston pa'i phyag na bsnams gyur pa// bden pa'i tshig ni de dag gis// sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog /de bzhin lha mo 'phrog ma yis// lha rdzas dge ba a ru ra// blangs nas ston la rab phul ba// bdud rtsi 'dra ba'i sman gyi rnams// bden pa'i tshig ni de dag gis// nad pa rnams kyi nad sel cing*// nyes pa thams cad 'phrog byed pa// sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog /sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gzi brjid dang*// gtsug tor can gyi stobs rnams dang*// thams cad skyob kyi bden tshig dang*// log dad sel gyi ting 'dzin dang*// gser zhes bya ba'i ye shes dang*// 'od srungs kyi ni rdzu 'phrul dang*// shākya seng ge'i mthu rnams kyis// sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog

/nad pa shar phyogs kha bstan la// sman rnams nye bar stsal bar bgyi// de yi tshe na rig sngags 'di// lag mthil bzhag ste bklag par bgyi// s+yād+ya the dan/ kha ṭe kha ṭe/ kha ṭa bi kha ṭe/ tsa le bi tsa le/ bi laṃ be/ ba le ba la ba te/ tsan+t+ri/ tsa ra ṇe/ a mṛ ta nir+gho ṣe swā hā/ rlung las gyur dang mkhris las gyur// bad kan las gyur 'dus las gyur// nad rnams thams cad rab bcom ste// bdag la rtag tu bde legs shog /bram ze rnams kyis bslus nas su// shākya seng ge skyob pa la// dpal sbas kyis ni dug can gyi// bsod snyoms dag ni phul ba dang*// de las de ni blangs nas su// ston pas dug ni bsad nas gsol// bden pa'i tshig ni 'di yis su// zas ni bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog /rnam par gzigs dang lha gang dang*// gtsug tor can dang kun skyob dang*// log par dad pa sel ba dang*// stobs chen lha gang dad pa dang*// gser dang dpal ldan 'od srungs dang*// shākya yi ni seng ge la// rab dad lha yi dbang po dang*// tshangs dbang sum cu'i dbang phyug dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi dag dang*// nor bu bzang dang dbang phyug che// srin mo nag mo chen mo dang*// de bzhin gdol mo gtum mo dag /me tog dang ni bdug pa dang*// bdag gi sbyin sreg 'di bzhes shig /de dag tshim zhing mchod gyur nas// bdag gi kha zas byang bar mdzod// zas lnga dag dang 'dres pa yang*// bdag la ma 'dres mdzad du gsol// kha zas lnga dang 'dres pa yang*// zas de kun ni bza' bar bgyi// sa bon dag gi tshogs kun la// sa yi bcud ni zhugs pa yi// kha zas 'dres pa thams cad kyang*// bdag la ma 'dres mdzad du gsol// ji ltar skud pa bcad bsregs kyang*// de lta bur yang slar 'byor pa// de ltar zas rnams 'dres pa yang*// ma 'dres par ni bdag la mdzod// s+yād+ya the dan/ kha kha me/ kha kha/ kha kha/ khu me/ shi shi me/ shi hu me/

shi ma shi me/ swa sti/ swa sti/ swa sti/ swa sti/ ma ma shān+ti/ shān+ta/ sha ra gri/ kha zas lnga dang 'dres pa yang*// ji ltar ma 'dres zas bzhin du// bdag gis ji ltar skud bsregs pa// de 'dra'i bden pa mdzad du gsol// s+yād+ya the dan/ ka la li/ ka la le/ ka la le/ khu khu me/ ag+ni/ saṃ gra ma ni swā hā/ sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs dang sangs rgyas gtsug tor can// bde gshegs kun skyob sangs rgyas log par dad sel dang*// gser thub 'od srungs shākya thub pa gau ta mya// bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba la skyabs su mchi bar bgyi// mi mchog bdun po de dag gi ni sku rnams la// me tog dag dang spos rnams kyis ni mchod par bgyi// lus dang yid kyang rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis ni// de dag rnams la skyabs su nye bar mchi bar bgyi// sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul che dang ldan pa de dag la// lha gang mngon par rab tu dang ba yod pa yi// lha de mgu zhing yid ni rab tu dga' 'gyur nas// rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis bdag la bsrung du gsol// 'jig rten 'di'am yang na 'das pa dang*// mtho ris dag na rin chen mchog yod pa'ang*// de bzhin gshegs pa lha yi lhar gyur pa// mi yi mchog dang 'dir ni mtshungs pa med// de bas 'dir ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /zad pa chags bral bdud rtsi 'dus ma byas// shes pas shākya thub de rab tu phye// bdud rtsi zhi ba 'dus byas ma yin pa// chos de dang ni mtshungs pa gang yang med// de bas 'dir ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /mchog tu gang 'dod tshul bzhin rab bstan pa// ston pa'i rnal 'byor bla med rtag bsgrub pa// rdo rje lta bu mi gnyis lam mthong ba// ting 'dzin de dang mnyam pa yod ma yin// de bas 'dir ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog

/gang zag chen po brgyad po rab bsngags shing*// gang zag zung bzhir brjod pa de dag ni// drang srong chen po gang zag mtshungs med pa// bde bar gshegs pas sbyin pa'i gnas shes gsungs// de la byin na 'bras bu cher 'byung ste// zhing rab gshin la sa bon btab pa bzhin// 'di ni dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /gang dag brtan pa'i yid kyis rab brtson zhing*// gau ta ma'i bstan la 'jug byed pa// de dag thob nas bdud rtsi 'jug thob ste// mun pa bsal nas mya ngan 'das thob pa// de bas dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /lta ba 'di la sbyar ma thag tu ni// 'jig tshogs lta dang tshul khrims brtul zhugs dang*// the tshom dang ni nyon mongs gsum po dag /cig car spangs te 'phags pa'i bden mthong ba// des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni mchog thob shog /lus sam ngag gam 'on te yid kyis kyang*// sdig pa rnam gsum nam yang mi byed la// glo bur byas na'ang 'chab par mi byed cing*// de ltar de dag lta bas 'dzin mi byed// de bas dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /ji ltar dbang po'i sdong po sar btsugs pa// phyogs bzhi'i rlung rnams kyis ni mi g.yo ltar// 'phags pa'i lam gyi dam pa mthong ba yi// gang zag 'phags pa'i dge 'dun de bzhin no// des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /shes rab zab mos shin tu bstan pa yis// 'phags pa'i bden pa su dag rnam bsgom zhing*// lus kyang sbyin par yid la byas pa ni// de dag 'jigs pa brgyad dang 'phrad mi 'gyur// des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog

/ji ltar me ni rlung gis rab gtor ba// lag tu blangs te bgrang du med pa nyid// de ltar kun du sbyor ba rab btang ba// sangs rgyas sras rnams bstan du med par 'gro// des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad 'dir ni bde gyur cig /ston mchog lha dang mi yis mchod 'os pa// sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad 'dir ni bde gyur cig /zhi ba chags bral lha mis mchod 'os pa// chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad 'dir ni bde gyur cig /tshogs kyi dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa// dge 'dun phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur te// sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung*// skye dgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing*// nyin dang mtshan du chos kyang spyod gyur cig /'di ni rgyal ba dgra rgyal bden gang gis// shin tu bden pa gsungs shing brdzun med pa// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /de kun 'jigs pa che las thar gyur cig swā hā/ shis pa brjod pa ste bco lnga pa'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
